description.value: Agate Beach Campground sits within Naikoon Provincial Park on Haida Gwaii, at the edge of vast wild Pacific beaches on Haida traditional territory; the park is a genuine wilderness with no supplies nearby, cash-only fees, and cool, rainy, windy weather possible any time.

address.value: Graham Island, North Coast, BC V0T 1R0, Canada

raw_osm.description: A nice seaside campsite, with drinking water and a cosy picknic shelter with a wood stove.
raw_osm.name: Agate Beach Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks Naikoon Park website explicitly confirms 'There is no internet access at Misty Meadows campground or Agate Beach campground,' corroborating the OSM internet_access=no tag. The OSM description provides the primary evidence for potable water and a covered picnic shelter with a wood stove, neither of which the website contradicts. The OSM operator phone (+1-250-626-3337) belongs to the Old Massett Village Council and does not appear on the BC Parks website, which lists only BC Parks' own contact numbers, so it cannot be confirmed from website content.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-626-3337) is the Old Massett Village Council operator number and does not appear on the BC Parks website, which only lists BC Parks' own contact numbers — cannot be independently confirmed.
No civic address provided in OSM; campground is located only by coordinates.
The linked website is the parent Naikoon Provincial Park page rather than a page dedicated to Agate Beach Campground, limiting the amenity detail that can be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active provincial park campground on Haida Gwaii with confirmed basic amenities; a valuable listing for touring cyclists on this remote coastal route.
